notes:
REF-BM-03: Collected title and description can be edited only after the bookmark has already been saved.
REF-BM-05: No bookmark deletion action exists.
REF-BM-10: Existing tags are displayed as unfiltered suggestion chips rather than offered through tag-entry autocomplete.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parentheses work, but quoted operator words are still parsed as operators instead of literal terms.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: There is no action applying to all bookmarks in the current filtered collection.
REF-BM-22: Bookmark sorting is not implemented.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML snapshot or PDF preservation is implemented.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is not implemented.
REF-BM-27: Archiving is reversible, but permanent deletion is unavailable.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are not implemented.
